questions.prompt: mini-dsh gets a second provider. Which code must change?
options: Only a new adapter, registered under the new provider name
The agent loop and the block assembler
The list of seven piece types
questions.explanation: The loop reads only shared pieces and picks an adapter by provider name. A new provider needs one new adapter with a stream method, and nothing else changes.

questions.prompt: The loop calls stream with provider 'nobody', and no adapter has that name. What does the loop receive?
options: An exception thrown out of the for await loop
An empty stream with no pieces
One finish piece with kind error
A text block that says the provider is missing
questions.explanation: The shared stream function catches the failure and converts it into a finish piece with kind error, so the loop checks for failure in one place.

questions.prompt: Why can the scripted adapter test the loop without any network?
options: The loop skips the assembler for scripted providers
The loop sees only shared pieces, so any code that yields them looks like a provider
The scripted adapter sends requests to a local copy of DeepSeek
Tests turn off the finish piece
questions.explanation: The loop never knows who produced the pieces. A function that yields a text delta, usage and finish is enough for the loop to run.

diagramRequest.title: One model request through the adapter seam
diagramRequest.show: The agent loop sends a request to LlmRuntime, which picks DeepSeekAdapter by provider name; the adapter sends one HTTP POST to DeepSeek. A text piece and a finish piece come back through the adapter and runtime to the loop and the BlockAssembler, and the whole block is written to the session record.
